name: Mandarin Oriental, Lago di Como
positioning: Lakeside resort on the shores of Lago di Como with lake-view rooms and suites, a floating pool and a spa
best_for: Travelers who want a lakeside resort with a spa
Couples looking for a romantic lake getaway
Families wanting a spacious suite for an extended stay

facts.text: The hotel sits on the shores of Lago di Como.
L˜ARIA serves Italian dishes with Japanese influences.
The terrace at L˜ARIA has lake views.
CO.MO Bar & Bistrot offers all-day dining with Italian favourites and signature cocktails.
The spa's thermal area has a whirlpool, ice pool, saline bath, Finnish sauna and steam bath.
The spa has two private Spa Suites.
The fitness centre has Technogym equipment.
The hotel offers Tesla X electric cars for short-distance transfers.
The spa treatment menu includes Team Dr Joseph and 111SKIN skincare.

highlights.text: The outdoor pool is a floating infinity pool designed by Herzog & de Meuron.
The resort's botanical garden has over 50 species of plants, trees and flowers.
The spa won Italy's Best Hotel Spa 2025 at the World Spa Awards.

considerations.text: The spa asks for 24 hours' notice of cancellation or modification to avoid 100% charges.
WhataHotel notes limited availability due to high demand.

perks.text: With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, breakfast for two is free daily.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a priority upgrade if available at check-in.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a $100 hotel credit.
WhataHotel special offers can be combined with the exclusive perks.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get free Wi-Fi access.
